items.html: Now, what remained in him is the aspect of the crowns of all the souls. And the matter is this: it has already been explained that after Adam sinned, he did not merit the souls of Aba ve Ima of Beriah, but only from Zeir Anpin and Nukva downward. And they are ten Partzufim, namely: Zeir Anpin and Nukva of Beriah, Aba ve Ima and Zeir Anpin and Nukva of Yetzira, and Aba ve Ima and Zeir Anpin and Nukva of Assiya. Now, every Partzuf includes ten Sefirot, and every single Sefira includes ten within it, hence every Partzuf comprises a hundred Sefirot, and the ten among them are their crowns, namely: the crown within the crown, the crown within Hochma, the crown within Bina, and so on. Thus, every Partzuf has ten crowns, and since there are ten Partzufim, they contain a hundred crowns, and these are the secret of the hundred cubits that remained in Adam HaRishon — they are the crowns within all the souls, for the Klipot [shells] did not rule over them, as mentioned.
